programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 439

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 1
programme.desc: Después de hacer un baile subido de tono, Mía es castigada por su padre. Miguel decide mudarse a la Ciudad de México para dar con la familia del hombre que mató a su papá. Mientras tanto, Roberta le demuestra a su madre lo rebelde que es.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 2
programme.desc: Mia conoce a Roberta y le ofrece hacerle un cambio de imagen, pero ella lo toma mal. Lupita, acompañada de su tía Mayra, aplica para una beca en el Elite Way School. A Miguel no le permiten hacer el examen de ingreso a la escuela.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 3
programme.desc: Tras presentar el examen, José, Nico, Lupita y Miguel son admitidos en la escuela. Celina ve a Miguel y se siente atraída por él. Curiosa por saber quién es el chavo del que le habla Celina, Mía conoce a Miguel y siente amor a primera vista.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 4
programme.desc: Miguel le encuentra a Mía un corazón con su nombre, pero ella le dice que es una broma. Mientras finge ahogarse para llamar la atención de Mauro, Roberta sufre un accidente real. Diego se mete en un altercado y es golpeado y herido con un cuchillo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 5
programme.desc: Roberta y Mía compiten por Mauro, pero éste dirige su atención a Alma, que viene a visitar a su hija. Diego afirma que sus heridas se deben a una pelea con Miguel. Pilar imprime unas notas que revelan secretos, provocando disputas en el grupo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Miguel amenaza a Mía por humillar a Celina. Mía se disculpa con Celina. Diego intenta vengarse de la persona que lo agredió, pero su padre interviene entregando al matón a la policía. Roberta, movida por los celos, insulta a Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 7
programme.desc: Casualmente Franco y Miguel se conocen. Tratando de ocultar que Diego está borracho, Mía lo besa. Aparece un nuevo anónimo y Diego cree que Roberta es la autora. Roberta besa a Mauro y Pascual los descubre.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Miguel le pide a Celina que sea su novia para conseguir información sobre el padre de Mía. Diego empuja a Roberta al lago, en venganza Roberta le tira la guitarra y él la amenaza con matarla. Otra carta anónima aparece, ante el temor de Roberta.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Un plácido cumpleaños
programme.desc: Es el cumpleaños de Plácido y nadie de la familia estará en casa para festejar con él, pues todos tienen cosas que hacer ¿con quién crees que festeje? O tal vez se quedará sin celebración y sin regalos.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - De lo perdido lo que aparezca

programme.title: Una familia de diez - El hijo pródigo
programme.desc: Han pasado tres meses desde la desaparición de Plutarco y la familia cuida de que Gaby no cometa una locura. La vida del abuelo ha cambiado drásticamente y ahora es un gran actor de Hollywood. Los López reciben una increíble sorpresa.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Pagan justos por pecadores
programme.desc: Debido a sus problemas con Hacienda, Don Justo decide esconderse en casa de los López. Después de una discusión, Martina se desmaya y la Nena tiene que cuidarla. Los López tendrán que dividirse entre atender a Martina y a Don Justo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - La doctora Licha
programme.desc: Durante su visita a la farmacia, la tía Licha es confundida con una doctora y se consigue una credencial falsa para recetar medicamentos. Don Justo condiciona el regreso de Plácido a su empresa a cambio de que le deje su cama para poder dormir.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Las aceitunas de Don Justo
programme.desc: Don Justo soborna a Justito y a Victoria para que no le digan a la familia que tiene dinero escondido. Enrique Durán, un antiguo amor de Renta, regresa para tratar de conquistarla de nuevo.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Mountain Memories: Montana Black Bear
programme.desc: Steven Rinella heads deep into Montana's rugged mountains to hunt black bears, reflecting on two decades of memories in this harsh yet captivating landscape. Joined by memories of his brother and their youthful adventures, Steve navigates grizzly country, contemplates the passage of time, and explores the evolving nature of hunting. Through encounters with both bears and the terrain, Steve seeks not just game but a connection to the past and the lessons it holds.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Living Off the Water: Kentucky Fishing
programme.desc: Steven Rinella joins his friend Kevin Murphy on a unique fishing adventure along the Mississippi and Ohio.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Nevada Mule Deer with Joe Rogan
programme.desc: Steven Rinella teams up with Joe Rogan in Nevada's high desert to bowhunt for elusive mule deer bucks. Surrounded by vast public lands and rugged terrain, they navigate the challenges of close-range stalking with their bows. With Joe's enthusiasm for archery and Steve's experience, the duo pushes their limits in pursuit of these wary deer, embracing the highs and lows of hunting in one of America's most unforgiving landscapes.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.desc: Steve and Janis are deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska on a challenging moose and caribou hunt. Joined by Janis' father, Papa Jani, who wants one last adventure before age catches up, they endure the highs and lows of remote hunting. With patience wearing thin and the weather turning, the group pushes through thick willows and foggy mornings, hoping for a bit of luck and a successful hunt before their journey's end.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Prince Of Wales: Fishing and Deer
programme.desc: Steven Rinella heads back to his fish shack on Prince of Wales Island in Southeast Alaska, this time with friend and colleague Morgan Fallon. Known for his cinematography, Mo now wants to switch roles from behind the camera to filling his freezer. Together, they embark on a classic Alaskan adventure: fishing for rockfish, setting shrimp pots, and hunting Sitka blacktail deer, all while reminiscing about past trips and discovering new ways the wilderness shapes them.

programme.title: MeatEater

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Prince of Wales: Sitka Blacktail Deer Part 1
programme.desc: Late October in Southeast Alaska finds Steve, Ryan Callahan, and Mark Borman chasing Sitka blacktail deer. As the bucks begin their descent from the alpine into dense timber, the trio faces the challenge of hunting in the thick, damp rainforest. While navigating through muskeg patches and testing their luck with calling techniques, they must contend with unpredictable weather and tough terrain. When deer prove elusive, they turn to fishing and foraging.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Prince of Wales: Sitka Blacktail Deer Part 2
programme.desc: Midway through a challenging hunt on Prince of Wales Island, Steve, Ryan Callahan, and Mark Borman are searching for Sitka blacktail deer. The rut hasn't kicked in as expected, leaving the hunters frustrated and the deer elusive. Adapting their strategies, they decide to split up and quietly stalk through dense woods and muskeg. After days of patience and perseverance, a mix of skill, luck, and determination finally leads them closer to success.

Navigating unseasonably warm November weather, they face challenges in tracking down the elusive deer as the heat pushes the animals into cooler, shaded areas. After several attempts, including a close encounter thwarted by coyotes, the duo finally spots a promising buck.

programme.desc: Amidst the dense fog and relentless rain of Afognak Island, Steve and Remi embark on a challenging elk hunt, navigating rugged terrain and the constant presence of brown bears. As visibility dwindles and the weather worsens, they push forward in one of the most unpredictable environments. It's a hunt that demands resilience, patience, and a deep respect for the wilderness.

programme.title: MeatEater

With Doug still hoping to take his first bull, the team sets up on a high ridge, watching caribou stream across the landscape. They face grizzly bears, dense fog, and the ever-changing weather of the Alaskan wilderness. As the days pass, they work together to intercept a herd of caribou, knowing their window could close.

programme.sub-title: MeatEater - El Venado Blanco: Mexico Coues Deer
programme.desc: Steven Rinella returns to his favorite hunting grounds of Sonora, Mexico to hunt for a Coues deer buck during the peak rutting season. Steve sets up camp and spends days glassing mountains and canyons for these elusive, wary desert whitetails. Meanwhile, his hunting partner, Remi Warren, attempts the difficult task of stalking one with a bow. To cap off the hunt, Steve cooks a batch of venison ribs braised in a Dutch oven buried beneath hot coals.

programme.title: MeatEater Cooks
programme.sub-title: Whitetail Deer with Mark Kenyon and Kevin Gillespie

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "FIRST SIT In Mississippi | Austin Riley Smokes A GIANT | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Atlanta Braves' third baseman Austin Riley is usually spending his September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs. Being that he can't hunt much during the early part of deer season, he usually hunts hard during December and January in Mississippi. This year was no different. He jumped at the opportunity to head down to the Backwoods testing grounds to hunt with the Small Town TV crew in Yazoo City. Austin capitalizes on a first sit opportunity on a true Mississippi giant over a Backwoods Attraction food plot! Three first sit bucks taken for the Road Trips crew at the Backwoods testing grounds!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "165" GIANT BUCK with a BOW | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Realtree's Ben McDonald gets luck again on his first sit in Nebraska. This time he rattles in an absolute giant whitetail into Bow Range.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "A MONARCH Of A Buck | Bowhunting Louisiana | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan is hunting a true giant at one of his favorite places to hunt in the Southeast. Honeybrake has been a great place to deer hunt for the Realtree crew over the last few years. Tyler Jordan and Ben McDonald decide to try their luck bowhunting at Honeybrake for a couple true southern ghosts.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "UNDERTAKER Hunting Sandhill Cranes | Catch Clean Cook | Ribeye Of The Sky RECIPE"
programme.desc: Realtree's David Blanton is joined by WWE's Mark Calaway aka "Undertaker" for a sandhill crane hunt in Texas. The crew put the Franchi Shotguns to work and were able to harvest the "Ribeye of the Sky." Check out the hunt and an awesome, simple recipe to enjoy sandhill crane for dinner!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "MONSTER Buck in NEBRASKA | OCTOBER Bow Hunting | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Greg Camp heads back to Nebraska for the third year in a row hoping to put his bow tag on a giant 10 Pointer.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.sub-title: Road Trips - "Hunting Tough Alabama Turkeys | Big Gobbler Finally Breaks | Realtree Road Trips"
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hunts with country music singer Riley Green on his farm in Jacksonville, Alabama. The first couple days of turkey season are met with difficult conditions, and they struggle to find turkeys that are willing to work. High winds make for rough hunting.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird"
programme.desc: Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target bucks.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Summer Prep And Randy Raven Bow Kill"
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: The Raven Project - "Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird Part 2"
programme.desc: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

programme.title: The Deeper You Dig (Edited Version)

As the Inns final days draw near, odd guests check in as the pair of minimum wage ghost hunters begin to experience strange and alarming events that may ultimately cause them to be mere footnotes in the hotels long unexplained history.

Now, someone - or something - is alive in the basement, and home sweet home is about to become a horrific hell on earth.

programme.title: The Beyond (Edited Version)

And on the day the gates of hell are opened, the dead will walk the earth!From legendary Italian horror master Lucio Fulci come the ultimate classic of supernatural terror. A remote and cursed hotel, built over one of the seven gateways, becomes a yawning malevolent abyss that begins devouring both the bodies and the souls of all who enter in a graphic frenzy of gory crucifixions, chunkblowing chain-whippings, eyeball impalements, sulfuric acid meltdowns, flesh-eating tarantulas, throat-shredding demon dogs and ravenous bloodthirsty zombies. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. programme.title: Dr. Phil

He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. programme.title: Dr. Phil

Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.
